extension.description: Coordinate multiple AI coding agents from one workspace.
configuration.language: Interface language of the Prometheon panel. Menus contributed to VS Code always follow the editor.
configuration.speech.language: Language spoken during dictation, as a two-letter code such as pt, en or es. Leave 'auto' to let the model detect it — accurate for long sentences, less so for short ones.
configuration.speech.pythonPath: Python used to create the dictation environment. Leave empty to search the system for Python 3.9 or newer. The engine runs entirely on this machine and needs no network.
configuration.language.auto: Follow the display language of VS Code.
configuration.language.en: English, the source language of the interface.
configuration.hub.url: Prometheon Hub base URL. HTTPS is required outside `localhost`. Leave it empty to work locally only. Tokens do **not** go here: they go to the VS Code secret storage.
configuration.chat.defaultType.local: Local Chat: works without an account and without a server.
configuration.chat.defaultType.web: Web Chat: requires a configured Prometheon Hub.
configuration.workspace.promptOnOpen: Show the setup screen when the open folder has no .prometheon/prometheon.yaml.
